event.title: TeraWulf sells its Abernathy joint-venture interest to a Fluidstack-led group
event.summary: TeraWulf sold its interest in the Abernathy joint venture, which is developing an AI data-center campus in Abernathy, Texas, to purchasers led by Fluidstack. The price is payable in three installments.

participants.note: Through its subsidiary Big Country Wulf LLC
Fluidstack CS I Inc. and other purchasers

amounts.label: Aggregate consideration
amounts.quote: The aggregate consideration payable to the TeraWulf Member in the Transaction is approximately $530 million, payable in three installments

quantities.label: Abernathy campus critical IT load
quantities.quote: The Abernathy Joint Venture was established in 2025 to develop a 168 MW critical IT load AI data center campus in Abernathy, Texas.

facts.label: Interest sold
facts.text: TeraWulf's entire 50.1% ownership interest in the Abernathy joint venture.
facts.quote: TeraWulf will sell its entire 50.1% ownership interest in the Abernathy Joint Venture to an investor group led by Fluidstack

facts.label: Installments
facts.text: $250 million within 14 days, $150 million by December 31, 2026, and about $130 million by April 30, 2027.
facts.quote: (i) $250 million within 14 days following execution of the Purchase Agreement, (ii) $150 million on or before December 31, 2026, and (iii) approximately $130 million, subject to certain adjustments, on or before April 30, 2027.

facts.label: Completion
facts.text: The sale became effective on July 5, 2026; TeraWulf no longer holds an interest in the joint venture.
facts.quote: The sale was effective as of July 5, 2026. The consideration is payable in three installments: $ 250.0 million within 14 days following the effective date which was received in July 2026; $ 150.0 million on or before December 31, 2026; and approximately $ 130.0 million due on or before the earlier of the date the Abernathy HPC Campus commences operations and April 30, 2027. As a result of the transaction, the TeraWulf Member no longer holds any equity interest in the Abernathy Joint Venture.

corrections.text: Updated the transaction from signed to completed using TeraWulf's November 2026 Form 10-Q, which states the sale was effective July 5, 2026.
